intent: A compact "what moved" card for a period: each metric shows before → after and a delta. Good and bad are set per metric (churn down is good), and direction and sentiment are always spelled out. An optional summary sentence leads, rows can be grouped into Better and Worse, and each row can carry a one-line why.
useWhen: summarise the changes between two periods on a dashboard or report
say whether each move is good or bad for the business
lead with one sentence on the period and say why each metric moved
doNotUseWhen: one KPI with a trend — Scorecard
a row of KPI tiles — Scoreboard

items.note: { id, label, before, after, delta, direction: 'up'|'down'|'flat', sentiment?: 'good'|'bad'|'neutral', why?: string }[] — values are pre-formatted strings; why is a one-line caption with no trailing period.

summary.note: The headline sentence above the rows. With no items it stands alone (a quiet month) instead of the Empty state.

groupBy.note: sentiment groups rows into Better, Worse and Steady, each with a count in a kit Badge. Default: one flat list.

onViewAll.note: Renders an outline neutral sm Button.

onAsk.note: Adds a neutral outline sm Button "Ask in Chat" with the MessageCircle icon, e.g. to open Chat on this period.

requirements: each row reads as one sentence, e.g. "MRR up +9.8%, good. $48.2K to $52.9K. Upgrades from Growth to Scale."; the visual row is aria-hidden
each group is an h4 (Better, Worse, Steady) with its count; its list is aria-labelledby that heading
the word good, bad or neutral is visible next to the values, not colour alone
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local DeltaList or MetricChanges
Do not colour by direction: sentiment is set per metric
Do not show arrows without the word
snippet: <ChangeSummary period="Oct → Nov" summary={headline} groupBy="sentiment" items={changes} onViewAll={openReport} onAsk={openChat} />
